briefdescription.para: Coordinator for fan-out parallel inference across multiple subagents with partial-failure handling and merge strategies.

simplesect.para: Orchestration Layer: Coordinates parallel inference across multiple subagents with merge strategies, partial-failure recovery, and result aggregation.

sect2.title: Purpose
sect2.para:
SubagentCoordinator enables parallel inference across multiple independent subagents while handling partial failures gracefully. It:
Distributes inference requests to multiple subagents (fan-out)
Collects results from all subagents (fan-in)
Handles partial failures (some subagents fail, others succeed)
Applies merge strategies (first-win, majority-vote, best-score)
Provides detailed failure diagnostics

sect2.title: Architecture
sect2.para:
The coordinator follows a fork-join pattern:
Request arrives for a set of subagents
Coordinator submits request to all subagents asynchronously (fan-out)
Each subagent infers independently and returns result
Coordinator collects results and merges using strategy (fan-in)
Final result is returned to caller (with partial-failure metadata)
Subagents are isolated: failures in one do not affect others.

listitem.para: FirstWin: Return first successful result (lowest latency)
MajorityVote: Aggregate results by consensus (requires structured output)
BestScore: Return result with highest confidence/quality score
Ensemble: Combine results from all subagents (e.g., average scores)

sect2.title: Thread Safety
sect2.para: All coordinator methods are thread-safe. The coordinator itself uses internal locks; subagents are accessed safely via future continuations.
